_comment: Sample Retell call_ended webhook payload for smoke-testing Template 01. Synthetic data based on the Retell webhook documentation as of 2026-05. IMPORTANT: the `call_ended` event does NOT include `call_analysis` - that field only ships in the separate `call_analyzed` event which Retell sends after post-call processing completes. If your workflow needs the analysis object, listen for `call_analyzed` instead (or in addition to) `call_ended`. Source: https://docs.retellai.com/features/webhook-overview. POST this body to your test-webhook URL with Content-Type: application/json. To exercise the HMAC verify path, also send the matching x-retell-signature header (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body, hex-encoded, signed with RETELL_SIGNING_SECRET).

call.transcript:
User: Hi, I called yesterday about a tour booking for next weekend. Did you save my preferences?
Agent: Yes, I have your details. You asked about the Tramuntana hike for two people on Saturday morning. Would you like to confirm?
User: Yes please, lock it in for Saturday at 9am.
Agent: Done. I'll send the confirmation to the email you gave me last time. Anything else?
User: That's all, thanks.
